title: Bevel footer
description: A quiet, airy white footer: the wordmark and a tiny copyright line on the left, four link columns (grey headings, medium ink links) running to the right edge, then a row of social icons and two small round compliance badges. On phones everything stacks into one column.
notes: badges are image slots; empty they are round placeholders
name: bevel-footer

props.name: socials
props.type: { icon: ReactNode; label: string; href: string; }[]
props.description: social links: an icon and a screen-reader label each

props.name: badges
props.description: compliance badges at the bottom right (images); round placeholders when empty

props.name: badgeCount
props.description: how many badge placeholders to show when badges is empty
